Buongiorno Luca,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0442958
. The ticket is open for a Failsafe mode on charger
C6fXJ0.
I connected remotely to the charger, and the communication to SECC-LE KF12 is lost. Hence, the failsafe mode.
Please proceed to replace the EcoG KF12. Here is the spare part required:
As we are seeing an increasing number of chargers in Italy going to failsafe mode due to loss of communication with EcoGs, I will drive in the next days an analysis on ISP to collect all cases so far reported, and evaluate if required to escalate to Product Care.
